speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are not just saving money on tooling, you are asking me to absorb a monthly manual review that I did not agree to. Acknowledge that this is a cost transfer from the platform budget to my team's labor, or we are not discussing it.
output.correction: I did not propose a full manual audit of the logs, I proposed a spot check of the top ten articles to keep the KPIs aligned with our strategy. Do not mischaracterize my efficiency proposal as a blanket removal of automated monitoring.
